price_scope: Previously exposed GP-v2 reference working point; not newly optimized, not proof of cost matching
candidate_seed_policy: Not frozen independent worlds until HPC registry/fingerprint prepare passes; collisions block, no silent replacement

comparisons.question: Native timestamp threshold mechanism; policy-level, not purchased information
Purchase-service and endogenous timing effects with information ignored
Purchase-service effects under the same native-only timestamp rule
Using paid timestamps under common purchase and service rules

selection_numerics: Compare scale/price on the same predecision catalog; report differences without assuming universal finite-precision equivalence
observation_equivalence: Every scientific result field, raw service events/logs, local belief/position/intent state, outstanding tasks and RNG counters; exclude only scheme/scope/compute_scope labels and measured selection_process_seconds
observation_cost: No new logical service reservations for experimental logging; real process/wall includes logging. Probe runs both observation states and reports overhead. No deployment efficiency claim.
probe_scope: Software/ledger/observation cost fixtures only. No ranking or selecting by task outcomes, CI/power planning, test N or paid-benefit inference from truncated probes.
causal_scope: Within-prestate re-selection identifies a decision mechanism only. Whole-policy contrasts include endogenous actions, histories and service paths; not a controlled direct effect of a single delivered message.
stop: Any source/contract/observer/world/resource mismatch stops downstream use; retain failure records. No parameter sweep, sample expansion, new services or training to rescue old No-Go.
next_gate: After HPC equivalence, ledger audit and bounded probe: produce a separately reviewable prospective calibration design and budget; do not execute calibration automatically. Reserved old test worlds remain sealed.
